title: Explicit number fields
summary: Numerically explicit inequalities for a number field K on Mathlib's carriers: explicit ideal counts (Sunley, Lee, Debaene, Fehnker, Gun–Ramaré–Sivaraman, and Ramaré for imaginary quadratic fields), explicit residue bounds for the Dedekind zeta function (Louboutin, Friedman, Stark, Garcia–Lee, and under GRH Garcia–Grenié–Lee–Molteni and Palojärvi–Simonič), class-number, regulator and relative class-number bounds (Louboutin, Bordellès, Cully-Hugill–Trudgian), explicit zero counts, zero-free regions and zero repulsion for ζ_K (Trudgian, Hasanalizade–Shen–Wong, Amberger, Stark, Louboutin, Kadiri, Lee, Das–Gaba–Lee–Savalia–Wong, Kadiri–Ng–Wong), the uniform real-zero gap for quadratic fields and its consequences, including an effective Brauer–Siegel bound for Galois fields (Guo; Banks; Lu–Zaman–Zhao), Odlyzko's discriminant bound, explicit bounds on the least primitive root modulo p and p² (McGown–Trudgian, McGown–Sorenson, McGown–Treviño–Trudgian, Kerr–McGown–Trudgian, Chen), and the explicit theory of prime ideals: Mertens' theorems (Garcia–Lee), Chebotarev unconditionally (Das–Kadiri–Ng) and under GRH (Grenié–Molteni), the least prime ideal (Ahn–Kwon, Kadiri–Ng–Wong, Bach–Sorenson) and Debaene's Brun–Titchmarsh inequality.
